text:
claire: opened a PR to add cascade21b model card + SDK v4 migration snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5124 Preview: https://deploy-preview.example/5124. Adds supported_variants, quantization_profiles, max_sequence_length entries for 12k/24k, and a short perf section. Please quick review.

omar: can we add p50/p95 tokens/sec for 12k and 24k on A100 and T4? ops wants numbers to recommend variants. Also add a curl example for quick tests.

claire: added simple bench numbers: 12k p50 330 tok/s @A100, p95 255; 24k p50 138 tok/s, p95 105. T4 approx 55% of A100. Noted dynamic-padding can reduce throughput ~10%. Added a one-line curl snippet for smoke tests.

pavel: small frontmatter nit: used "max_seq" in YAML; catalog schema expects "max_sequence_length". Linter will fail on CI.

claire: fixed frontmatter to "max_sequence_length" and pushed. thanks.

rachel: requested short streaming snippets for Python and a minimal curl streaming pattern so SDK users and infra SREs have copy-paste examples. Also check the quant_profile anchor — I think we link to "#quant-profiles" but site uses "#quantization-profiles".

claire: added Python streaming and curl examples. Python snippet:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
for chunk in client.generate("cascade21b", input="Draft a blurb about X", stream=True).stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

curl smoke test:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"cascade21b","input":"Hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq -r '.text'
```

claire: fixed quantization anchor to "#quantization-profiles" and updated internal TOC.

omar: can eng-ml sign off on the CPU-quant fallback wording? avoid definitive claims about hallucination; recommend running representative evals. @pavel?

pavel: updated language: "CPU quant fallbacks (e.g., cpu-int8) may increase latency ~2-4x and can alter short-token choices; run quick evaluation on key prompts before rollout." linked to internal bench artifact: https://bench.internal/cascade21b/5124

docs-bot: preview build passed ✅ staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/5124. Lint: 0 errors, 1 warning (link style) resolved.

claire: added a short migration checklist in the PR description (field rename to max_sequence_length, new quant_profile enum values, and snippets for Python/curl). requesting final reviews from @omar @rachel @pavel and will merge after one approval. :rocket:
